notes.text: The heading includes the heir (היורש) and an abbreviated title, retained as R'. The notice cites Gittin, chapter 8, halakhah 2. That format suggests the Jerusalem Talmud, but the source does not name it and no edition/modern locator is verified; He is the contextual entry subject.
